title: Form Validator Test
description: Test exercise with vague requirements to demonstrate the validation tool.
requirements: Use React.useState to manage email input (starting as empty string)
Use React.useState to manage password input (starting as empty string)
Render a submit button with text 'Submit'
Show an error message if email is invalid
Show an error message if password is too short
Error messages should appear as paragraph elements
Export the FormValidator component as the default export

browserTests.name: Shows email error for invalid email
No email error when valid email typed
Shows password error for short password
No password error when long enough
